module: "Biome Tool" (edit mode "Edit Biome") of the level editor: generates vegetation (Forest objects) and paints terrain materials in layers. Two layer types (terrain = 0, area = 1); "area" layers contain lasso zones (inclusion/exclusion) or zones by terrain material. Each layer has fields (forest density, slope influence and range, falloff and border density, Add/Replace/Delete blending method, field placement with distance/rows/orientation, random area by RA_* noise, edge placement EP_*). The tool relies on ForestBrushTool and the forest brushes. Layers are read from <level>/art/biomeTool/biomeTool.json at initialization and rewritten after each level save.
notes: Almost the whole file is local (140 local functions); the exported API is limited to 5 hooks. The "var" table is the internal state of the tool, not an exposed class; its get/setEP* methods are listed in classes.var for reference.
Bug: M.onExtensionLoaded = onExtensionLoaded references a variable never defined in the file: the exported field is nil.
If no Forest object exists, onEditorGui opens a "NoForestObjDialog" modal window offering to create one (worldEditorCppApi.createObject('Forest'), named "theForest").
On load and save, the level path is deduced from getMissionFilename() (second segment of the path); the biomeTool.json file is deleted then rewritten only if at least one layer exists.
The var.setEP* functions sometimes return fieldInfo.val (default value of the template) when they create the field, and nil otherwise: unreliable return value, to be ignored.
var.setEPRandomTiltRange modifies the table passed as a parameter (range is reused as slopeRangeValid).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Is nil: reference to a variable never defined in the file.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every editor frame. Does nothing outside the "Edit Biome" mode. Otherwise checks for the presence of a Forest object (creation dialog otherwise) and draws the interface (Level Biome / Biome Areas tabs), the lasso, the zones and the highlight animations.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Initialization: loads the level's biomeTool.json if it exists, fills the list of forest brushes and materials, registers the biomeEditMode edit mode (biome_tool icon), the "biomeTool" window (500x560), the NoForestObjDialog modal window and the custom field editors (TerrainMaterial, BlendingMethod, SlopeRange, VegetationFalloff, FieldPlacement, RA_Map).

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: Hook: when the "biomeTool" window is hidden, switches back to the objectSelect edit mode.

onEditorToolWindowGotFocus.desc: Hook: when the "biomeTool" window gets focus, activates the biomeEditMode edit mode.

windowName.desc: Name of the window that got focus.

onEditorAfterSaveLevel.desc: Hook called after the level is saved: writes the layers (var.layers) to <level>/art/biomeTool/biomeTool.json (old file deleted first). Does nothing if there is no layer.

var.desc: Internal state table of the tool (layers, zones, lasso, forest brushes, generation queue). Only a few accessor methods for the "edge placement" fields and the bounds are defined on it; layerType is 0 (terrain), 1 (area) or 2 (any, in the field templates).

getFieldMinMax.desc: Returns the {min, max} bounds of a field of the fieldInfoTemplate template for this layer type; {0, 0} if not found.

layerID.desc: Layer ID (not used in the computation).

getEPRandomTiltRange.desc: Returns the random tilt range (EP_RandomTilt field) of a layer; {-5, 5} by default if the layer does not have this field.

returns.desc: {min, max} in degrees (inferred from code, range -40 to 40).

setEPRandomTiltRange.desc: Sets the EP_RandomTilt range of a layer, clamped to -40..40; creates the field if missing. The passed table is modified.

getEPFalloff.desc: Returns the border falloff (EP_BorderFalloff, -10 to 10) of a layer; creates the field with the default value (0.0) if missing.

returns.desc: Current value, nil if the field is unknown.

setEPFalloff.desc: Sets EP_BorderFalloff of a layer, clamped to the field's minValue/maxValue; creates the field if missing.

getEPItemDistance.desc: Returns the distance between objects for edge placement (EP_ItemDistance, -10 to 10, default 1); creates the field if missing.

setEPItemDistance.desc: Sets EP_ItemDistance of a layer, clamped to -10..10; creates the field if missing.
